message: Hey Jane, I really need to talk to someone. I've been struggling with anxiety lately and it's been tough. I haven't told anyone else, and I trust you to keep this between us.
Great job today, everyone! Our sustainable garden project is looking amazing. Can't wait to present it to Mr. Thompson and the rest of the class!
Good morning, Jane! Hope you have a fantastic day at school. Tell me all about it when you get a chance.
Don't forget, we're meeting up at 10:00 AM for the Green Earth Club project. See you there!
Can't wait for tomorrow, our project is going to be so cool!
Hi Jane, just checking in. How are things going? Anything new or exciting happening?
Thanks for being there for me today. It means a lot to have a friend like you.
Reminder: Bring your ideas for the sustainable garden tomorrow!
Looking forward to the Green Earth Club meeting tomorrow. Our project is going to rock!
Hey Jane, I'll be out of town for a few days. Let's catch up when I'm back. Take care!
